question.text: Consider the given figure and choose the correct option :

options.text: Activation energy of both forward and backward reaction is $\mathrm{E}_1+\mathrm{E}_2$ and reactant is more stable than product.

Activation energy of backward reaction is $\mathrm{E}_1$ and product is more stable than reactant.
Activation energy of forward reaction is $\mathrm{E}_1+\mathrm{E}_2$ and product is more stable than reactant.
